description: This file contains unit tests for the QuicSocketAddress class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing socket address initialization, conversion, normalization, and socket operations.

classes.name: QuicSocketAddress
classes.description: A class representing a network socket address used in QUIC protocol.

methods.description: Test for streaming socket address output.

methods.name: FromSockaddrIPv6

methods.name: ToSockaddrIPv4
